baseline.type: Modeled Windows filesystem/captured spawn/probe only. Existing valid Scripts-layout private venv is refused before any package mutation. This records missing supported feature, not a native install failure.

existing_hunks: _pip_environment_commands: delegate valid Windows-only case before unchanged POSIX guard
_run_pip_environment_update: dispatch Windows adapter; leave POSIX code unchanged
start_update_helper: environment branch only, select platform adapter and outside helper
_run_plan: add pip-private-windows-v1 to pip dispatch set only, coordinate root Debian elsewhere
ownership.new_helpers: Windows-specific private top-level helpers under install_cleanup.py; no new spacr modules or nested helper API paragraphs. Actual normal visibility still verified before publication.
ownership.root_caller_dependency: app.py _poll_frozen_update private adapter-ID additions and existing restart-state save gate; deliver scratch patch to root/Easy, do not mutate their caller tree.

proposed_boundary: Only ordinary dedicated running Windows venv: canonical/samefile real directory, Scripts python.exe/pythonw.exe, pyvenv.cfg with no system-site packages, no conda/editable/shared root, correct current runtime identity. No external or live environment is installed into.

External base Python must be verified from actual current interpreter context, resolve outside target and stage, remain immutable and run helper -I -B. Never run replacement helper using target Scripts/python.exe, whose loaded executable/DLLs can prevent Windows directory retirement.

Owner/current-user Windows ACL and no-reparse guards bind target parent and helper/transaction directories. Possible standard PowerShell Get-Acl/WindowsIdentity JSON readback with canonical OS powershell -NoProfile/-NonInteractive, no credentials or elevation; model ACL reader separately on Linux. Refuse unsafe/unavailable ACL proof before mutation.

Existing authenticated readiness/approval/cancel protocol; actual old app process must exit before copy/package staging and activation. No user profile/Conda/shared environment fallback. Copy and pip upgrade only sibling staged runtime, then pip check/import/exact distribution/module/interpreter/floor validation.

Windows entrypoint EXEs cannot use POSIX shebang replacement. Regenerate ONLY changed staged-prefix-bound console/gui wrappers through normal pip-vendored distlib ScriptMaker with final interpreter path; update owning RECORD hashes/sizes normally and reject ambiguous ownership. Preserve preexisting arbitrary unchanged scripts and old runtime bytes. Validate real Windows launcher payload construction offline without executing Windows binary on Linux.

Windows lacks existing POSIX atomic directory exchange: explicit journal-bound old->retained, stage->active two-rename commit with immediate rollback on handled exception/identity/import/relaunch failure. Never claim atomic/no-gap or power-loss recovery. Full inventories and file identities guard each transition; ambiguous state retains both/evidence and refuses foreign overwrite. Current old runtime is retained, never recursively deleted.

Reuse exact current source-mtime collision prevention for changed equal-size/same-second Python sources in owned stage, preserving external caches and old runtime. Do not refactor passing POSIX engine just for reuse.

Positive/negative model cases plus real disposable filesystem renames, rollback injection, normal launcher-generation subprocesses and byte inventories. Native Windows file-lock/ACL/desktop/full dependency/power-loss acceptance remains explicit. No native claims or feature capability enabled before all ordinary source contracts pass.
specific_review_questions: Approve journaled two-rename handled-failure scope with explicit interruption/native acceptance debt, rather than pretending Windows has POSIX exchange.
Confirm normal distlib regeneration/RECORD closure is required; do not accept merely changing Scripts paths and leaving copied EXE launchers pointing to staging.
Confirm ACL reader can use built-in read-only PowerShell (unavailability conservatively refused), or require direct WinAPI security reader before any mutation.
